name: Fujimoto Hiroshi
source:
The protagonist. When his mad scientist friend Yuuichi turns him into a young man again through experimental cloning and memory implanting he discovers that all his daughters now want him.

Because he's young again he quits his job for fear of not being recognized. His wife Kanoko must work extra hard leaving him with plenty of spare time to spend with his daughters.
